name: @usrp/feature-scheduling
description: Signed QR invitation verification (offline-capable). NO server operation exists yet: scheduling-service is a scaffold.
//dependencies: @usrp/api-client is declared for its EdgeOperationId type, which this slice uses to assert — at compile time — that its operation list is EMPTY and correct. Its one former operation, getSlotInvitationKey, exists nowhere in the platform. What remains real is verifying a signed QR token the device already holds, which needs no endpoint.
//peerDependencies: React, ReactDOM and the router are PEERS, not dependencies. The host app owns the single instance; a second React in the graph throws 'invalid hook call' and resolves context to the wrong provider. The devDependency copies exist only so this slice typechecks and tests standalone.
